dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Yeah! Move it! Move it! There you go!

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Hell yeah, girl! Shake what ya mama gave ya! Haha!

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Woooo! God, I haven’t had this much fun in a looong time. Everything feels soo warm and woozy but- it feels sooo goooodd, haha!

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Girl, you are druuuunnk! Now that’s what I like to call a good time! Seeeee, not everything is sooo badddddd!

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Ha, I guess not! I’m sorry I judged you guys too soo-
So this is where you’ve gone to hide. How could you, I trusted you. I thought you were different. WE... had something.
YOU KNOW BETTER THAN TO ABANDON THE GANG. YOU KNEW THE RULES. YOU KNEW THE CONSEQUENCES. YOU’RE MARKED FOR DEATH. I don't wanna do this to you but-

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: GO, run, run! Everyone in here, get the hell down!

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: W-what’s happening!? Who was that?? Why do you have everyone in the goddamn state chasing after you, papi?! What did you do?!

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: I wanna know too! But first, hmph, we gotta get outta here! Things are gonna get serious! Ugh- Baby, how much did you have to drink??

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: AYE! STOP THE FUCKING CAR! POLICE! Gogogo, y’all! Head down the street, blend into the crowd, lose ‘em! I got a plan and it won't be pretty.

dialogue.name: Taxi Driver:
dialogue.text: These damn kids nowadays. Drugs will do that to you.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Look look look! There’s a train station two blocks from here! If we take the train from there, we can easily travel out of the city and lose their ass!

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Exactly, good thinking, Jasmine! Let’s take the E train to Jamaica Center! Just stay behind me and watch my back. Chances are she's not gonna be far. When she comes through the carts, I'll be ready.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Got it! Me and Jasmine will search the carts! Just get inside, hurrryyy! Hop the fare! I swear I'll have my parents pay for it in the end!
